text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon and I are on our way
home after
a day out and about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What would you consider to be
"precious
memories" that we share?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: いきなりどうしたんだ？

text_block_list.text:
She tells me the topic came up in class
earlier.

Apparently, everyone had some kind of
precious
memory they shared with their
trainer. On the
other hand, Mihono
Bourbon was confused.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What does "precious" mean?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm unable to adequately comprehend its

definition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Precious" means something of value...
Something
you do not want to break.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, how is that related to
memories?
Memories are not tangible
things that can be
broken.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What makes a memory "precious" is
something I
am unable to quantify.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pops into my head?
choice_data_list: パッと思い浮かぶものはない？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Error. Due to an innumerable amount
of search
results for memories, I am
unable to narrow it
down to only
"precious" ones.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've determined that obtaining a better

understanding of "precious" is necessary
before
searching my memory logs.

She seems like she still can't understand
what
makes a memory precious. In that
case, there's
only one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You wish to create even more memories
in order
to help me understand what
makes them
"precious"?
choice_data_list: 思い出をたくさん作ろう！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Simply put, experiencing the
feeling in real
time may be the fastest
way to achieve
comprehension...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: さっそく、思い出を作ろう！

text_block_list.text:
The following evening, Mihono Bourbon
and I
visit the park.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Many of the other students' precious
memories
were related to receiving
advice from their
trainers.
choice_data_list: 公園でしたいことでも？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based upon that, I've deduced that the
perfect
conditions for discussing my
troubles are "in the
evening," "at a
park," and "alone together."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is why I brought you here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: 悩みがあるなら、いくらでも聞くよ

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I am "at a loss." I apologize. I
do not
have any particular troubles.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Failure. Moving to next method.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Fun at the park... Do you mean you wish
to play
tag?
choice_data_list: 試しに普通に遊んでみる？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Now, who will be "it" first?

For whatever reason, Mihono Bourbon
and I end
up playing tag together at the
park.

It goes without saying that I'll be tagged
in an
instant if she's "it," and she'll never
get tagged if
I'm "it."

The results are obvious from the start.

Unfortunately, this won't end up as a
precious
memory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Failure.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I detect what is known as "labored
breathing." I
suggest you rest
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We can continue creating memories next
time.

Today is a complete bust. I should
probably come
up with my own plans for
next time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Try harder? Isn't that what I should be
doing?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Thank you for your
assistance,
Trainer.

Mihono Bourbon gazes at me intently as
she
offers her words of thanks, and we
make a
promise to create our own
precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. As you wish, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have detected a decline in your
stamina. It
appears that walking is
causing you difficulty.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will carry you to a bench.

I sit down on a bench and let out a deep
sigh. The
expression on Mihono
Bourbon's face tells me
that she wants to
say something.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I have failed to achieve my
goal today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To make matters worse, I have caused
you to
become physically exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the day's events will become an

"unpleasant" memory for you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I... I see. Thank you very much.
choice_data_list: これはこれで、思い出だから

text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon thanks me and smiles at
the
prospect of trying to make precious
memories
again.

She looks down for a moment as if deep
in
thought before giving me a small nod.
